en.title: The simple past
en.summary: The simple past tells about a finished action at a definite time.

paragraphs: The simple past (also called the past simple) describes an action or state that began and ended in the past, usually at a time that is stated or understood. It is the basic tense for telling what happened.
Regular verbs add -ed to the base form. Irregular verbs have their own past forms, which must be learned. The past form is the same for every person, with the one exception of was and were.

blocks.html:
TypeBasePastExample
regularwalkwalkedShe walked home.
regular (ends in -e)livelivedWe lived in Leeds.
regular (consonant + y)studystudiedI studied French.
irregulargowentThey went to Spain.
irregularbuyboughtHe bought a car.
bebewas / wereI was ill. They were late.

paragraphs: The auxiliary did forms questions and negatives for all verbs except be. The main verb goes back to the base form because did already shows the past.

blocks.html:
FormExample
statementShe saw the film.
questionDid she see the film?
negativeShe did not (didn't) see the film.
with beWas he ill? He wasn't ill.

items: Add -d to verbs that end in -e: **live → lived**.
Change y to i after a consonant: **try → tried**, but **play → played**.
Double the final consonant after a short stressed vowel: **stop → stopped**, **plan → planned**.
Wrong: **Did she saw it?** Right: **Did she see it?**
Wrong: **I didn't went.** Right: **I didn't go.**
Wrong: **I have seen him yesterday.** Right: **I saw him yesterday.** (a finished time needs the simple past)

ro.title: Trecutul simplu
ro.summary: În limba română, exprimăm o acțiune terminată în trecut cel mai des prin timpul perfect compus.

paragraphs: Timpul trecut arată o acțiune care a început și s-a terminat deja. În vorbirea curentă, limba română folosește perfectul compus pentru trecut. Folosim acest timp pentru fapte petrecute la un moment precis.

Formăm perfectul compus cu verbul auxiliar „a avea” și participiul verbului de bază. Auxiliarul își schimbă forma pentru fiecare persoană. Participiul rămâne la fel pentru toate persoanele. Pentru negație, punem cuvântul „nu” în fața verbului auxiliar.

blocks.html:
PersoanăAuxiliarExemplu
EuamEu **am citit** o carte.
TuaiTu **ai vorbit** mult.
El / EaaEa **a sosit** ieri.
NoiamNoi **am plecat** devreme.
VoiațiVoi **ați mâncat** tot.
Ei / EleauEi **au terminat** tema.
